description: nodes preserves form/head/relation/UPOS and lowercases lemma, falling back to form for empty/_ lemma. animacy chooses first category from exactly one nonempty animate/inanimate family after exception suppression; both or neither means Unknown. violation checks role-specific fixed selection lists. arguments selects first noun child by index, with AuxPass presence switching agent/patient relation sets. check processes only VERB nodes; after any violation a known, clean swapped pair yields one RoleSwap flag, otherwise subject then object flags. run aligns gold by nonempty sent_id map or position and skips misaligned scoring.
